title: Choose the console's visual world
question: The roll assigned Papan Harga Pasar. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Papan Harga Pasar
options.lineage: the market price board — painted numbers on a ruled wooden board, read standing up in one glance
options.thesis: Network health as a market board: live availability and money as painted figures on one ruled surface.
options.viewport: A dark wood rail over two ruled columns: availability by outlet on the left, money on the right, a painted total at the foot of each.
options.risk: A board only reports what it counts; a metric nobody feeds leaves the whole screen falsely calm.

raised.raise: Coloured status lines per outlet, so a late return reads as a line that changed colour rather than a number.
An exception row that holds amber and never re-sorts away, so a late return stays visible until acknowledged.
Hairline seams instead of shadows, so panels divide by 1 px rules rather than elevation.

options.label: Buku Besar
options.lineage: the shop's big ledger — ruled paper, ink, running totals, red corrections
options.thesis: Network health as a ledger: every movement a row, every total a running balance.
options.viewport: A ruled sheet with a ledger column on the left and three settled totals on the right.
options.risk: Also the arrangement most runs in this category land on — familiar, and familiar is not the same as finished.

options.label: Peta Jaringan
options.lineage: the midnight transit mural — coloured lines bending at 45 and 90 degrees, interchange circles blooming at crossings
options.thesis: The network as a diagram: outlets as nodes, state as coloured lines, transfers as interchange circles.
options.viewport: A midnight-blue field with five outlet nodes joined by four coloured lines, a legend and three live counts.
options.case: Fuses well: a network admin reads the system as movement, and coloured lines carry state at a glance — but the diagram tempts navigation that the admin does not need.
options.risk: Beautiful and readable, but it makes the network look like a journey when the admin only needs a verdict.

options.label: Rak Jadwal
options.lineage: the pocket timetable on a lit goldenrod bed — tinted glass slides raked 11 degrees, one type size, rank by weight and case
options.thesis: The day's outlets as a raked rack of slides: each outlet restates its own heading, the late one held amber.
options.viewport: Three raked glass slides over a goldenrod bed, the late outlet's slide held amber and never re-sorted.
options.case: Fuses on the exception: a row that reranks and stays lit is exactly how a late return should behave — but the rack is a travel document worn by a bike network.
options.risk: Charming and precise, but the rake is decoration unless the exception row does real work.

options.label: Konsol Gelap
options.lineage: the dark-first developer console — graphite ground, hairline seams, syntax-derived accents, isolated destructive actions
options.thesis: The console as graphite panels: hairline seams, syntax accents, destructive actions given deliberate empty space.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the developer console is a costume on an operations desk, and graphite panels fight the glanceability a health screen needs.
options.kept: Hairline seams instead of shadows — panels divide by 1 px rules, not elevation.

options.label: Katalog Padat
options.lineage: the convention circle catalog — thousands of postage-stamp thumbnails packed into a numbered hall grid
options.thesis: The network as a dense grid of stamp-sized entries, each outlet a cell with a code and a mark.
options.case: Fuses poorly: stamps are for browsing, and an admin reading health does not want a landscape to wander.
options.kept: Whole-cell grid repacking on narrow screens, so density survives the viewport.

options.label: Selubung Saville
options.lineage: the Factory Records catalog sleeve — matte black, white hairline pulse plot, hue blocks standing in for words
options.thesis: Each outlet as a coded entry: a hue strip and a fac number, decoded only when you look.
options.case: Fuses poorly: vast black gives a slow console a point of view, but decoding costs the visitor time on a screen that should answer at a glance.
options.kept: Vast unprinted black plus code-as-state, where the code carries the status.

options.label: Baris Data
options.lineage: Ikeda's datamatics — dense barcode columns and sine lattices strobing in pure black and white
options.thesis: The network as a field of barcode columns, state read as a wave travelling across them.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the strobe is an art statement, and pure black and white cannot carry the amber and red an operations screen needs.
options.kept: Tabular numerics at true data density, so counts scan as columns.

canonCard.label: Standar kategori
canonCard.thesis: Konsol admin yang umum dikirim kategori ini: tanah putih, rail kiri, aksen biru, tabel sortable.
canonCard.viewport: Rail kiri, strip KPI, tabel outlet sortable di atas tanah putih.
canonCard.risk: Tidak bisa dibedakan dari kompetitor secara desain.
